svg.title: AV-05 · The Unified Operating Systemverse · candidate-v1 · 2026-08-30
svg.desc: A master unified geometry combining the Systems Verse, the Six Process Constellations, and the Beehive honeycomb matrix into one coherent operating architecture diagram. Centered around a sun-gold Data Core (MDM + CDM), surrounded by a functional honeycomb matrix (The Beehive), anchored by six cardinal process constellation pillars (P2P, O2C, P2M, S2S, D2R, MDM) with BPSc weight bands, and encircled by 16 Systemverse functional application nodes connected through a woven integration fabric backbone.

g.text: Systems Verse · Six Process Constellations · The Beehive
One geometric frame: 6 categorical process flows × 16 functional systems × 1 data core
